subject: Re: Q4 venue contract and next steps

reply_to.author: Dana Rivera
reply_to.text: Hi! Attaching the revised venue contract. Could you look over section 4 (cancellation terms) and the catering minimum before Friday? We also need a final headcount by the 4th so the venue can lock in staffing. Let me know if you want to hop on a call.

body:
Hi Dana,

Thanks for sending the revised contract. I went through it this morning and have a few notes:

1. Section 4: the 30-day cancellation window works for us, but can we get the deposit refund at 50% instead of 25%?
2. Catering minimum: $4,500 is fine as long as it includes the coffee service.
3. Headcount: we're tracking at 85 right now. I'll confirm the final number by Dec 3.

I marked up the PDF with comments (attached). The full schedule draft is here too: https://docs.example.com/schedule/q4-offsite

Happy to jump on a quick call Thursday afternoon if that's easier.

Best,
Alex
